import os
programs='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u061/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(programs, exist_ok=True)
path=os.path.join(programs,'task-5c9f10f2.py')
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                step_r = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                step_c = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                r, c = r1, c1
                while True:
                    out[r][c] = 1
                    if (r, c) == (r2, c2):
                        break
                    r += step_r
                    c += step_c
                segments.append((r1, c1, r2, c2, 1 if dc * dr > 0 else -1))
    for r, c in sixes:
        on_segment = False
        slope = 0
        for r1, c1, r2, c2, s in segments:
            dr = r2 - r1
            if (c - c1) * dr == (r - r1) * (c2 - c1) and min(r1, r2) <= r <= max(r1, r2) and min(c1, c2) <= c <= max(c1, c2):
                on_segment = True
                slope = s
                break
        if on_segment:
            dc_step = -slope
            rr, cc = r, c
            while 0 <= rr - 1 < h and 0 <= cc - dc_step < w:
                rr -= 1
                cc -= dc_step
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = 6
                rr += 1
                cc -= dc_step
    return out
'''
open(path,'w').write(source)
print(path, open(path).read())
